evidence: The precious Mediterranean red coral, Corallium rubrum, is an octocorallian species, which produces two distinct high-magnesium calcite biominerals, the axial skeleton and the sclerites.
We combined High-Resolution Mass Spectrometry and transcriptome analysis to study the OM composition of the axial skeleton and the sclerites.
pooled axial skeletons and sclerites
the extraction process produced 2 OM fractions, the water-soluble organic matrix (SOM) and the water-insoluble organic matrix (IOM)
NanoLC-MS/MS analysis was performed once on each sample
